title: ‘Lal Mandir was original target’: How traffic forced Red Fort bomber to change plans
content: The National Investigation Agency filed a charge sheet detailing the Red Fort vehicle-borne IED attack.  The bomber initially targeted Lal Mandir but was diverted by traffic and police presence.  He detonated the explosive near Red Fort Gate No. 4, killing eleven people.  The device was triggered remotely using a mechanism fitted into the bomber's shoe.  This attack was the first vehicle-borne IED incident reported in the national capital.

title: Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications & price in India of iPhone Duo
content: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at Rs 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23.

title: Pakistan cricket team mistaken for asylum seekers in bizarre Portsmouth mix-up

A local councillor clarified the misunderstanding, and the protesters departed quickly. This incident occurred amid rising tensions following asylum seeker arrivals in the city. The England and Wales Cricket Board is reviewing security for the visiting team.

The accused allegedly provided keys and facilitated entry for the hired killers.  Police arrested the woman and two accomplices following an investigation and encounter.

title: Kesha sells Los Angeles mansion for $6.68 million after two years on the market

The singer purchased the Mar Vista home for $4.95 million in 2020 and stands to make almost $1.7 million before expenses. The seven-bedroom estate features a pool, rooftop deck, guest house and music room.

title: Belgium sinks 23 giant concrete blocks to build world's first energy island
content: Belgium is constructing the world's first artificial energy island in the North Sea. This massive structure will collect electricity from offshore wind farms and transmit it ashore. The island's design incorporates nature-inclusive elements to support marine life and bird species. While civil engineering nears completion, electrical infrastructure installation will continue until 2030. The project aims to become operational around 2030, enhancing European electricity exchange.

title: Apple increases prices of iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air & iPhone 16

The iPhone 17 now retails for Rs 99,900, marked up by Rs 17,000, whereas the premium iPhone Air skyrocketed by Rs 30,000. Highlights of the new iPhone 17 encompass a 120Hz display and upgraded 48MP cameras.

title: PM aide: E20 cap likely for existing vehicles

Moreover, ethanol producers are urged to look into compressed biogas and enhanced product offerings for a sustainable future.

title: SC registry urged to list defamation case against Rahul Gandhi
content:
NEW DELHI: The complainant who had filed a criminal defamation case against leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi for his claim of Chinese incursions into Indian territory Wednesday complained to SC that the registry is not listing the appeal for hearing, apparently because of the personality involved. Appearing for Uttar Pradesh govt, senior advocate Gaurav Bhatia said SC had stayed the proceedings in the criminal defamation case against Rahul on Aug 4 last year and despite a specific date being given by the court for hearing Rahul's appeal, the SC registry has not listed the matter. Rahul's counsel S Prasanna objected to Bhatia's contention and requested the court to not take cognisance of it. The CJI Surya Kant led bench told Bhatia to make an application seeking early hearing of the appeal so that the mattercould be posted for hearing. TNN

End of Article
